title: Illustration Magazine #63
content: I just got my copy ofIllustration Magazine #63. In the new issue they focus on the work of Saturday-Evening-Post cover artist Elbert McGran Jackson, whose work is reminiscent of Norman Rockwell and J. C. Leyendecker. The article tells Jackson's life story and evokes the era when illustrators hung out with movie stars and lived in mansions, and their work generated hundreds of letters of sharp-eyed readers.The second feature is on Mario Cooper, who used watercolor and dye pigments for his illustrations in Colliers and American Weekly.Illustration Magazine #63is 96 pages and is packed full of color reproductions.
